# Field Guide

An outline-shaped document: open the sidebar with Ctrl+B and switch to
the Outline tab. Scroll and watch the bold row track your position;
click chevrons to fold branches; click a title to jump.

## Habitats

The oryx crosses gravel plains at dawn, before the heat settles.

### Dunes

Sand holds the night's cool an hour longer than rock.

### Gravel plains

Wide, flat, and honest: nothing approaches unseen.

#### Waterless stretches

Weeks pass without standing water; moisture arrives as fog and roots.

## Behavior

Herds drift apart by day and re-form at dusk along remembered lines.

### Migration

#### Northern routes

Old paths, walked so long they read as roads from the air.

#### Southern routes

Younger paths, redrawn after each rare rain.

### Signals

A turned head carries further than a call in dry air.
